def transform(grid):
    # Repeat each source row in a horizontally mirrored 2x expansion;
    # tile the resulting vertical pattern three times with alternating reflection.
    base = [list(reversed(row)) + list(row) for row in grid]
    rows = base + base[::-1] + base
    return rows

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(transform([[6]*4 for _ in range(7)]))
PY
